approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would update the Building Energy Efficiency Disclosure Act 2010 to use the standard penalty and notice rules from the Regulatory Powers Act.
It would repeal the existing civil penalty and infringement notice provisions in the BEED Act and replace them with the corresponding framework under the Regulatory Powers Act.
The bill would also modify how the Regulatory Powers Act applies to keep certain existing powers in the BEED Act, such as the maximum penalty amounts.
Repeals the current civil penalty and infringement notice divisions in the BEED Act.
Applies the standard civil penalty and infringement notice provisions of the Regulatory Powers Act to the BEED Act.
Modifies the operation of the Regulatory Powers Act to preserve existing powers in the BEED Act.
Commercial building owners, sellers, and lessors subject to the Commercial Building Disclosure Scheme.
